steps.en: OCMS puts the individual's ID into the address-check queue
steps.id: OCMS memasukkan ID individu ke antrean pengecekan alamat
steps.why_en: Only NRIC and FIN enter the check route; a foreign passport has no route.
steps.why_id: Hanya NRIC dan FIN yang masuk jalur pengecekan; paspor asing tidak punya jalur.

steps.en: OCMS sends the ID number to the immigration and government data sources
steps.id: OCMS mengirim nomor identitas ke instansi imigrasi dan data pemerintah
steps.why_en: NRIC goes through MHA, not immigration; sending FIN is switched off in the production settings.
steps.why_id: NRIC dikirim lewat MHA, bukan imigrasi; pengiriman FIN dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.

steps.en: OCMS receives the latest registered address
steps.why_en: The latest address is received and kept temporarily, but not applied to the letter data.
steps.why_id: Alamat terbaru diterima dan disimpan sementara, tetapi belum diterapkan ke data surat.

steps.en: OCMS receives the pass type and validity of foreigners
steps.id: OCMS menerima jenis dan masa berlaku pass orang asing
steps.why_en: Pass type and validity are not taken for returned reminders.
steps.why_id: Jenis dan masa berlaku pass tidak diambil untuk kasus reminder yang dikembalikan.

steps.en: OCMS flags whether the registered address has changed
steps.id: OCMS menandai apakah alamat terdaftar berubah
steps.why_en: Old and new addresses are not compared, so a change is not flagged.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pembandingan alamat lama dan baru, jadi perubahan tidak ditandai.
